cd /work && python3 - << 'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
MAIN="/work/submission/main.py"
doc = json.dumps({"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[]})
for pad in (2097152-len(doc), 2097152-len(doc)+1, 2097151-len(doc)):
    data = (doc + " "*pad).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",MAIN],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    print("len=%d rc=%d out=%s" % (len(data), p.returncode, p.stdout[:60]))
# long valid-ish label under limit
big_label = "a"*1000000
d2 = json.dumps({"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":big_label}],"rounds":[]})
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",MAIN],input=d2.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("long label rc=%d out=%s" % (p.returncode, p.stdout[:60]))
# many edges but valid: 384 edges chain-ish
edges=[{"u":i,"v":i+1,"ping_us":10000,"ack_us":10000,"label":"lab%04d"%i} for i in range(95)]
d3 = {"version":1,"n":96,"capacity":[48]*96,"edges":edges,"rounds":[{"launch_us":1000000000,"timeout_us":1000000,"host_delay_us":10000,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",MAIN],input=json.dumps(d3).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
r=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("chain rc=%d" % p.returncode, json.dumps(r["summary"]), json.dumps(r["rounds"][0])[:160])
print("metrics", json.dumps({k:v for k,v in r["metrics"].items() if k!="cache_peak"}))
PY
